featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie posted twice this week with one of the sharper takes on the "AI capability vs. GDP impact" gap. His argument: AI diffusion will take far longer than people think, and it will show up in ways GDP can't measure quickly. You could drop the world's greatest superintelligence into a workflow and still be bound by the laws of corporate physics — getting data prepared and into a pipeline, process reengineering, change management, aligning on how the new workflow should function. Even past all that, yo…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这两天连发两条，把"AI 能力很强但 GDP 没反应"这个老问题拆得比大多数分析都清楚。他的判断是：AI 的扩散速度会比所有人预期的慢得多，而且它体现出来的方式在短期内根本无法被 GDP 统计到。你可以把世界上最强的超级智能塞进某个工作流，但仍然被"企业物理定律"卡死——数据要准备好并接进管线、流程要重新设计、变革管理要做、新工作流怎么运转还得所有人对齐。就算这些全解决了，你还是被现实世界的速度绑住：等客户回复提案、等项目批文、等一条药物研发管线跑上好几年。更别说大量日常 AI 用例对 GDP 的净影响本来就接近于零。他的结论是：AI 扩散会是未来十年的主题，而机会恰恰在于建造"超级智能"和"真实世界工作流"之间的那些桥梁。另一条讲 coding agent：他认为世界对 coding agent 的用法会远超今天任何人的想象——为过去付不起软件费的公司写软件、用 agent 防御网络风险、自动化生命科学研究、处理复杂工作流里的海量数据、升级遗留系统。代码成本降低的结果不是工程师变少，而是软件变得更有用、工程师的杠杆急剧放大，因此需要的工程师反而更多。

featured.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman posted a welcome note to someone named Paul, thanking him for everything he's done for AI safety and saying he's excited to work together again — the phrasing suggests a significant safety-side return. A second post matters more operationally: responding to capacity pressure, he wrote that "this would suck, but we will prioritize great service for customers until we can get back on top of things." For enterprise buyers that's a plain signal on how OpenAI ranks priorities when compute is const…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 发了一条欢迎帖，迎接一位名叫 Paul 的人加入，感谢他"为 AI 安全所做的一切"，并表示很高兴能再次共事——从措辞看是一次安全方向的重量级回归。另一条则更值得运维视角关注：他回应算力紧张的话题时说"这会很难受，但在我们重新掌控局面之前，我们会优先保证客户的服务质量"。对企业用户来说，这是一个直白的信号：OpenAI 在容量受限时的优先级排序是"付费客户服务 > 其他"。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper offered a methodological critique of a widely shared report on AI's labor impact. He calls the report well designed but flags two embedded assumptions that change the analysis once you probe them: that jobs can be decomposed into tasks, and that human tasks created by automation are always modeled as a fraction of automated tasks — meaning automation is assumed to always reduce human labor, or at best leave it flat. Taking them in reverse: does automation always reduce human work? In his expe…
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 对一份关于 AI 就业影响的研究报告做了很有价值的方法论批评。他承认报告本身设计得好，但指出两个会彻底改变结论的隐含假设：一是"工作可以被分解成任务"，二是"自动化创造的人类新任务永远只是被自动化任务的一个分数"——换句话说，模型内建了"自动化总是减少人类劳动（最多持平）"的前提。他反过来打这两点：自动化是否总是减少人类工作？他的经验是否定的——自动化往往为人类创造成倍的新工作。至于"工作能否分解成任务"，他说这是个有用的透镜，因为它让"一份工作有多少可被自动化"这个问题变得可计算，但那只是"被我们的提问方式所暴露的工作"，不是全貌。他的核心质问是：在这个模型里，新任务从哪里来？任何诚实的 AI 经济影响分析都必须认真对待"工作创造"这一侧。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方产品账号
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official Claude account announced a new batch of Claude Marketplace listings: CrowdStrike, Cursor, Factory AI, Gamma, and Vercel. The mechanic that matters: enterprises can now use their existing Anthropic spend commitment to buy these Claude-powered products and agents. That effectively turns an Anthropic enterprise contract into a wallet spendable across the ecosystem — a new path for customers with large commitments to convert budget into deployed capability. Anthropic is also recruiting supply: tea…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方的 Claude 账号宣布了 Claude Marketplace 的一批新入驻方：CrowdStrike、Cursor、Factory AI、Gamma、Vercel。关键机制变化在于——企业现在可以用自己在 Anthropic 的支出承诺额度（spend commitment）去采购这些 Claude 驱动的产品和 agent。这实际上把 Anthropic 的企业合同变成了一个可以在生态内消费的钱包，对已经签了大额 commitment 的客户来说，是一条把预算转化为落地能力的新路径。同时 Anthropic 也在招募：在 Claude Platform 上做产品的团队可以申请上架，让客户更容易采购。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared a notable platform-economics stat: in the last 6 months alone, Vercel shipped 8 price cuts, fee removals and pricing structure improvements, plus 16 model discounts — with more coming. For teams running AI workloads on Vercel, that's more direct evidence of the continued slide in inference cost. He's also promoting "AI Benchmarks," a Vercel × Benchmark event on model evaluation, which he calls one of the most important software categories of our generation: the companies that benc…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 晒了一组值得注意的平台经济数据：过去 6 个月内，Vercel 做了 8 次降价 / 取消费用 / 结构性定价改进，外加 16 个模型的折扣，并且还有更多在路上。对于在 Vercel 上跑 AI 应用的团队来说，这是推理成本持续下行的又一个直接证据。他还在推 Vercel 与 Benchmark 合办的 "AI Benchmarks" 活动，主题是模型评测这个品类——他称之为"我们这代人最重要的软件品类之一"：那些评测模型、并把世界引导向能力、真相和效率的公司。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人
items.summaryEn: OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux publicly handled an incident: that morning some banked resets weren't fully applying in ChatGPT Work and Codex. The response is the notable part — everyone who used one in the affected window automatically gets another reset plus an apology email, with no user-side claim required. For enterprise buyers, how a vendor handles and auto-remediates this kind of incident says more about maturity than the incident itself. His other posts were team color: debating new mode…
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 公开处理了一次事故：当天早上 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 里有一批"已入账的额度重置（banked resets）"没有完全生效。他的处理方式值得注意——所有在受影响时间窗内用掉额度的用户会自动再获得一次重置，并收到一封致歉邮件，不需要用户自己申诉。对企业采购方来说，这类事故的处理透明度和自动补偿机制，比事故本身更能说明供应商的成熟度。他另外两条是团队日常：和研究员一起吵新模型该叫什么名字是最大的乐趣之一（"他们能想出最离谱的东西"）。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 核心开发者、前 PSPDFKit 创始人
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw core developer and former PSPDFKit founder Peter Steinberger shipped two updates. First, cloud sessions are finally working and fast, with Remote Terminal, WebVNC and CUA (computer use) — meaning agents can now do GUI-level work on remote machines. Second, the Dashboards/Mini-Apps capability he pushed two months ago has now replaced a lot of the custom tooling his team had built around OpenClaw: everything is a sidebar entry, a dashboard or a plugin on their team server. That's a classic platformization s…
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 核心开发者、前 PSPDFKit 创始人 Peter Steinberger 报了两个进展。一是云端 session 终于跑通并且快了，配套上了 Remote Terminal、WebVNC 和 CUA（computer use）——这意味着 agent 可以真正在远端机器上做图形界面级别的操作。二是他两个月前推动的 Dashboards / Mini-Apps 功能，现在已经替换掉了团队围绕 OpenClaw 自建的大量工具：一切都变成了侧边栏条目、dashboard 或者插件。这是一个典型的平台化信号——当自建工具开始被平台原生能力吃掉时，说明抽象层设计对了。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials and interviews creator Peter Yang shared his favorite way to test a new model's thinking ability: ask it for brutally honest feedback about the blind spots holding you back (just paste the whole image into ChatGPT). He notes Astra's feedback was especially blunt. It's a practical capability probe — arguably better than standard benchmarks at revealing whether a model is actually reasoning or just flattering the user. He's also pressing OpenAI on when mobile ChatGPT will support Work and Remote Codex t…
items.insightZh: AI 教程与访谈创作者 Peter Yang 分享了他测试新模型思考能力的偏好方法：让模型给出"关于你的盲点、那些真正拖住你的东西"的残酷诚实反馈（把整张图片贴进 ChatGPT 即可）。他说 Astra 给出的反馈尤其不留情面。这是个实用的模型能力探针——比标准 benchmark 更能测出模型是否真的在推理，还是在讨好用户。他同时在追问 OpenAI：ChatGPT 移动端什么时候支持 Work 和 Remote Codex 线程？目前看起来只有 Chat 线程可用。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · SPC 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: SPC general partner, former Dropbox CTO and Bevel Health co-founder Aditya Agarwal used an event announcement to make a larger point: Waymo is one of the greatest examples of human-oriented technology, but it took a long road to get here — Dmitri Dolgov joined Google's self-driving project in 2009 and now co-leads Waymo as co-CEO. That timeline is itself an antidote to current AI narratives: technology that actually changes the physical world usually takes well over a decade from project start to scale. Dolgov is…
items.insightZh: SPC 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO、Bevel Health 联合创始人 Aditya Agarwal 借一次活动预告讲了个更大的点：Waymo 是"以人为本的技术"最好的范例之一，但走到今天是条很长的路——Dmitri Dolgov 2009 年就加入了 Google 的自动驾驶项目，如今是 Waymo 的联席 CEO。这个时间跨度本身就是对当下 AI 叙事的一剂解毒剂：真正改变物理世界的技术，从项目启动到规模化通常要十几年。Dolgov 本月会去 SPC 做客。
